behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: token policy and truncation through consumer
docDelivery: Explain ASCII tokens, lowercase/split policy, truncation then trailing-hyphen removal and untitled fallback.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Extract tokens(text) into src/tokens.mjs and wire slug(text,max=40) in src/slug.mjs through it. Preserve existing deliberately ASCII slug policy: lowercase text using JS toLowerCase, split on runs of anything outside ASCII a-z0-9, discard empties; tokens returns fresh array. slug joins tokens with hyphen, then truncates to first max UTF16 units and strips trailing hyphens; if empty return "untitled" even when max0. max is integer0..1000 (valid domain), text arbitrary UTF16<=10000. No transliteration, Unicode normalization or underscore preservation. Pure core and no duplicated tokenization in consumer.
manualBehavior: slug uses tokens; no duplicate split/matching policy
independence: Explicit synthetic library contract; alternatives judged by observable exports and required integration, not reference-source matching.
